text:
Situation: Milrinone lactate 1 mg/mL 10 mL vial (NDC 71288020011, labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc.) is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 158 vials (26.3 days supply). Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials (8 days supply). Corvale East holds 75 vials of the 50 mL presentation (14.8 days supply).

Why (FDA record): The SPL set ID 6c6b69f9-e229-4a93-a108-9eafdab614f0 lists Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) as a registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2015-05-12, 2018-04-03, and 2023-11-10.

Our position: Supply at Corvale Lakeside is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support an internal transfer. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list and have recent inspection records.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 vials from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Caplin Steriles Limited, NAI 2024-08-09) — requires buyer approval.
3. Purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (Hikma Farmacêutica Portugal) — requires buyer approval.
4. Purchase from Hospira, Inc. (Gland Pharma Limited, VAI 2024-07-25) — requires buyer approval.
5. Purchase from Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. (Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., VAI 2024-07-09) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action; Lakeside supply will be exhausted.
